+,x,1,t17

LABEL,l10,,
ASSIGN,1,,flag
IF_FALSE_GOTO,flag,,l13
PRINT,"la bandera es verdadera",,
GOTO,,,l14

LABEL,l14,,
INPUT,a1,,

>,b1,5,t29
||,expr7,t29,t30
